title: 第13章 唐山第14章 原形毕露卡显威趁着天命之子打架掳走气运之女
lines: “山哥，这次天骄大战，我们一定要崭露头角！”
白云城的大街上，舞月婵蹦蹦跳跳的，很是活泼可爱。
在她的身边还有一名样貌平平无奇的男子。
一身粗布麻衣，看上去土里土气，但是浑身上下充满了一股傲气。
一头飘逸的蓝色短发也是吸引了一些女性的目光，只可惜大多看到他的样貌后就不感兴趣了。
“小舞，不要太过招摇，老师说了，我们的实力必须尽量隐藏起来，不能让旁人知道的太多！”
唐山一脸正经的嘱咐开口。
“知道了。”舞月婵的两只耳朵一下子就耷拉下来了，看上去很是委屈。
周围很多的路人都是频频看向这一对很不搭配的男女，女子长得灵动活泼，可爱迷人，这男的嘛……也还算是个人。
无数人扼腕叹息，鲜花插在了牛粪上。
但是也没有人上来搭讪，天骄大战即将开启，这时候的白云城内部监管很是严格，白云帝国王室很重视此次天骄战，没有人会愿意在这风口浪尖闹事。
两人很快来到了一处客栈之中。
“掌柜的，来一间上好的厢房！”
唐山走上前，直接扔下了两枚灵石。
“一间？山哥，你住哪里？”舞月婵一惊。
唐山脸一黑，无奈道：“月婵，我们这次出门盘缠带的不够就只能将就一下了。”
“你不会嫌弃你山哥哥吧？”
舞月婵面露难色，虽然自己和唐山也算是青梅竹马，但是相见的时候也已经十二岁了，平日里也是很注意避嫌的。
现在忽然让她和山哥一起住一个房间，虽然内心没有太过于反感，但是一点少女的羞涩还是有的。
“我怎么会，但是山哥，我记得我们好像带了不少盘缠来着。”舞月婵嘟哝道。
“是我在管钱还是你在管钱？”唐山淡淡道。
掌柜的看了眼唐山的穿着，不屑冷哼一声：“不好意思这位先生，区区两枚灵石在我们客栈连马厩都住不上，您还是去往别家吧。”
“你说什么？！”唐山怒喝开口。
眼前之人竟然敢瞧不起他？
此人已有取死之道！
“我说，穷逼就滚到别的地方去住？我们客栈恕不接待！”
掌柜的淡淡开口，语气之中满是轻蔑与嘲讽。
眼前的傻缺进门前都不看牌匾的吗？这种地方是这种土鳖能够消费的起的地方吗？
他要是拿多点灵石出来，自己还高看他一眼，尼玛的，两枚灵石？打发叫花子呢？
“小哥，这客栈是白云城最好的客栈，哪怕是最下等的客房也需要一百枚灵石才能住一个晚上！”
一个好心的顾客开口提醒道。
如同在盛怒的唐山头上浇了一盆冷水。
“哥，走吧，我们的全部身家加在一起也不够住几个晚上的！”舞月婵感觉无数道目光落在自己的身上，只觉脸上火辣辣的，非常的尴尬。
唐山看了眼舞月婵，拳头握的很紧。
转过身准备离开。
content_en:
"Brother Shan, we must stand out in this battle between geniuses!"
On the streets of Baiyun City, Wu Yuechan was jumping up and down, very lively and cute.
Beside her was an ordinary-looking man.
Dressed in coarse linen clothes, he looks rustic, but his whole body is full of arrogance.
His flowing short blue hair also attracted the attention of some women, but unfortunately most of them were not interested after seeing his appearance.
"Xiao Wu, don't be too ostentatious. The teacher said that our strength must be hidden as much as possible and we can't let others know too much!"
Tangshan asked with a serious look on his face.
"I know." Wu Yuechan's ears suddenly drooped, looking very aggrieved.
Many passers-by around were looking at this mismatched pair of men and women. The woman was smart, lively, cute and charming, and the man... was still a human being.
Countless people sighed, and flowers were placed on cow dung.
But no one came up to strike up a conversation. The Prodigy War was about to begin. At this time, the internal supervision of Baiyun City was very strict. The royal family of the Baiyun Empire attached great importance to this Prodigy War. No one was willing to cause trouble in this turmoil.
The two soon arrived at an inn.
"Shopkeeper, come to a nice private room!"
Tangshan stepped forward and threw down two spirit stones.
"One room? Brother Shan, where do you live?" Wu Yuechan was surprised.
Tangshan's face darkened, and he said helplessly: "Yuechan, we don't have enough luggage when we go out this time, so we have to make do with it."
"You won't dislike your brother Shan, right?"
Wu Yuechan looked troubled. Although she and Tangshan were childhood sweethearts, they were already twelve years old when they met, and they were very careful to avoid suspicion.
Now she was suddenly asked to live in a room with Brother Shan. Although she didn't feel too disgusted in her heart, she still felt a bit shy of a girl.
"How could I, but Brother Shan, I remember that we seemed to have brought a lot of money with us." Wu Yuechan muttered.
"Am I in charge of the money or are you in charge of the money?" Tangshan said calmly.
The shopkeeper took a look at Tang Shan's clothes and snorted disdainfully: "I'm sorry, sir, but two spiritual stones can't even accommodate a stable in our inn. You'd better go somewhere else."
"What did you say?!" Tangshan shouted angrily.
How dare the person in front of him look down on him?
This man has a way to die!
"I said, why don't you just go and live somewhere else? Our inn won't accept you!"
The shopkeeper spoke calmly, his tone full of contempt and ridicule.
Did the stupid guy in front of me not even look at the plaque before entering? Is this a place where this kind of country bumpkin can afford to spend money?
If he brought out more spiritual stones, he would look up at him, damn, two spiritual stones? What about sending beggars away?
"Brother, this inn is the best inn in Baiyun City. Even the lowest guest room requires a hundred spiritual stones to stay in for one night!"
A kind customer reminded me.
It was like pouring cold water on the angry Tangshan.
"Brother, let's go, our entire wealth combined is not enough to stay for a few nights!" Wu Yuechan felt countless eyes falling on her body, and felt that her face was burning and she was very embarrassed.
Tang Shan glanced at Wu Yuechan and clenched his fists tightly.
Turn around and prepare to leave.
title_en: Chapter 13 Tangshan Chapter 14 The true identity is revealed and Luka shows his power and takes advantage of the Son of Destiny’s fight to kidnap the Girl of Luck.
